subject: Signer routing playbook for Ariba/Coupa handoff
messages:
From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@brighthealth.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: lisa.green <lisa.green@brighthealth.com>, procurement@brighthealth.com
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Signer sequencing + PO acknowledgement before portal enrollment

Hi Jonas / Kim,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Two quick items from procurement that are blocking our Ariba enrollment and the order form finalization:

1) Signer routing: our legal team needs confirmation of the exact signer sequence you expect for the MSA + order form. Do you require sales signature first and then customer sign, or is Redwood expecting a finance PO ack before final signature? That affects our internal approval workflow.

2) PO acknowledgement: our Coupa/Ariba team flagged that Redwood needs to accept the PO ACK window and the invoice remit fields. We have a copy of your preferred PO mapping but need one consolidated playbook with the expected signer routing so we can map to our SSO and approval rules.

Attached: OrderForm_BrightHealth_2027-10-11.pdf (order form draft) and a short portal field map from our side. Can your legal and ops teams align on the signer sequence and confirm any routing requirements (e.g., sign by sales, countersign by legal, finance acknowledgement)?

We’re targeting portal enrollment this month but can’t proceed without the routing clarified.

Appreciate quick turnaround — can you confirm by EOD tomorrow?

Best,
Sandeep Rao
Procurement Manager, BrightHealth
Attachments: OrderForm_BrightHealth_2027-10-11.pdf

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@brighthealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Signer sequencing + PO acknowledgement before portal enrollment

Sandeep — thanks for the clear ask. High level plan from Redwood:

- For speed to portal we prefer the order: Sales rep signature (digital) -> Redwood finance ACK of PO (email + portal ACK) -> Customer legal final signature.
- If your procurement system requires PO issuance before legal signature, we can accept that so long as Redwood finance receives the PO and clicks ACK in the portal within the agreed ack window (Net 30 by default).

Kimberly and Markus, can you confirm whether this sequencing creates any legal exposure or requires an MSA amendment (we'd rather not create a special SOW flow here).

If legal signs off, I’ll prepare a short playbook (1 pager) we can attach to the Ariba/Coupa enrollment packet — will include exact signer emails, required fields for PO ack, and the portal steps.

Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@brighthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Signer sequencing + PO acknowledgement before portal enrollment

Jonas / Kim — quick legal note and proposed playbook items.

Summary: no material change to MSA needed if we treat the sales signature as execution intent followed by customer legal signature as the formal execution, provided Redwood finance acknowledges PO in the portal and we record the acknowledgement timestamp in our contract folder. To be safe: we should capture the ack step as a required acceptance event in the Order Form (one sentence insertion) and track the portal ACK URL/timestamp.

Proposed signer routing (recommended):
- Step 1: Sales rep (signed) — internal record of intent; include signer name/email and timestamp.
- Step 2: Redwood Finance PO ACK — finance to acknowledge PO in Ariba/Coupa within X business days (we propose 3). Capture ACK screenshot/portal ID.
- Step 3: Customer Legal sign — final signature that binds both parties. If customer requires PO before signature, accept but require finance ACK as above.

Action items for ops/playbook:
- Add a short clause to Order Form: "Execution is the final signature by Customer Legal. Acceptance of Purchase Order by Redwood Finance via portal ACK does not substitute Customer signature but constitutes acceptance of the PO terms for provisioning and billing purposes." (we'll circulate a tracked-changes snippet).
- Legal will attach Redwood_MSA_v3_track_changes.docx with the tiny insertion as a suggested amendment to the Order Form.
- Ops team (Marissa/Mateo) please create the signer routing playbook entry that lists the exact email addresses and the screenshot requirement for PO ACK. That playbook will be attached to the enrollment packet.

I’ll send the tracked-changes doc shortly.

Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v3_track_changes.docx

Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 15:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Signer sequencing + PO acknowledgement before portal enrollment — playbook attached

Sandeep — thanks for the patience. Attached is our signer routing playbook and the redline snippet Markus proposed. Highlights:

- Playbook PDF (attached to this mail) includes: exact signer emails for Sales, Finance ACK flow, required portal ACK screenshot (PNG or URL), and the OrdForm clause to insert.
- Legal redline: small insertion to the Order Form that clarifies ACK does not replace Customer signature.
- Ops checklist: Marissa and Mateo will perform enrollment once we receive your portal admin invite and confirm the PO ack behavior during a short smoke test.

Next steps:
1) Sandeep to share portal admin invite / vendor registration ID in Ariba by EOD Wed.
2) Marissa to run a smoke test for PO ACK and confirm Redwood finance can ACK within 3 business days.
3) Markus to confirm final redline language; if BrightHealth approves, we’ll ask for countersignature via DocuSign.

Attaching: Redwood_MSA_v3_track_changes.docx, OrderForm_BrightHealth_2027-10-11.pdf, Portal_Field_Map_Ariba.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to the handoff call after the smoke test.

Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Attachments: signer_routing_playbook.pdf, Redwood_MSA_v3_track_changes.docx, Portal_Field_Map_Ariba.xlsx
